notes: «يذكر أراه عن جابر» : the narrator is unsure («أراه») that Abu Salih's source is Jabir; the text names him, so he is kept and the doubt is recorded (rule 9).
«وحدثني أبو سفيان عن جابر عن النبي بهذا» is a second isnad after the saying: its own group (rule 4). «بهذا» refers to the same wording, not to the isnad, so it is not a back_reference.
